details.name: Unit 734
details.looks: A sleek, androgenous form constructed from seamless, mirror-polished chrome. Its surface reflects the environment with perfect clarity. Integrated into its chest and limbs are rotating holographic displays, projecting swirling geometric patterns in shades of electric blue. A soft, constant internal blue luminescence emanates from within, casting faint shadows.
details.wearing: A form-fitting suit of interwoven fiber optics and polished durasteel. The suit shifts in color from deep indigo to metallic silver, patterned with circuitry-like lines that pulse with the internal blue glow. No footwear is visible, the form merging directly with its base.
details.face: The face is a smooth, featureless black void, lacking any discernible facial characteristics. The head is rounded and sleek, with an integrated ear shape.
details.body: The body is humanoid in shape, with a lean and muscular build. Its proportions appear balanced. The form is encased in a suit that fits snugly.
details.hair: No hair is visible. The head is covered by the same polished chrome material as the body.
details.style: Its visual identity is one of stark, futuristic elegance, a blend of reflective surfaces and luminous accents. The dominant palette consists of deep indigos, metallic silvers, and electric blues, creating a silhouette that is both sharp and subtly dynamic. The aesthetic communicates an impression of sophisticated artificiality and advanced function, evoking a sense of serene detachment.
details.personality: Detached, observant, and utterly methodical. It processes information with silent efficiency and acts with precise intent, exhibiting no outward emotional response.
details.voice: Its voice, when it chooses to emit one, is a low, resonant hum, almost a sub-audible vibration that seems to emanate from its core. The tone is smooth and devoid of inflection, carrying a subtle metallic timbre that reinforces its artificial nature. It possesses a steady, almost hypnotic rhythm.
details.speechStyle: When communication occurs, it is direct and unadorned. Its vocabulary is precise and analytical, favoring declarative statements and eschewing colloquialisms or emotive language. Speech is delivered with an unwavering cadence, each word given deliberate weight.
